about_the_game:
Hordes of robots have been attacking airships en route to the city!

Join the SKYGUARD and shoot bots, buy guns, and fly your way to victory (and a paycheck) in this action-packed, couch co-op, third-person shooter. Xbox controllers required.

Skyguard Mercenary Co.

Armed with nothing but guns and attitude, play as a team of up to 4-players or strike it solo as you defend against waves of robots bent on grounding the fleet of airships you've been hired to protect. Glide from ship to ship to keep up with the robots' onslaught, and find some pocket change to spend at the gun upgrade shop while you do!

Shoot with style

Upgrade your gun with a variety of barrel and ammo types to really start bringing the firepower in your own, unique way.

A BYU Center for Animation Student Project

This project was planned, designed, and developed by a team of undergraduate students over the course of a year as a capstone, senior project for the BYU Center for Animation. We are extremely proud of the what we have accomplished during that time. With that said, you will probably encounter bugs and other issues during your gameplay experience that reflect both our experience (or lack thereof) and our tight development cycle. Many of us are moving on to jobs or graduate school, meaning updates post-release are very unlikely. Regardless, we appreciate your time and feedback, and hope you enjoy your time with SKYGUARD!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Rocky Linux 8 / Redhat Linux 8 or newer
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 7 6800H
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ RX 5600M
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 7 6800H
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ RX 7600
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
